note: The Midnight structured reference string (SRS) payloads `zkir-v3 compile` needs, one per distinct `k` among the port's nine provable circuits, pinned by SIZE and SHA-256. These files are NOT in this repository (they are hundreds of MiB in aggregate and are gitignored); `scripts/release-artifacts.sh` obtains them from the source below and refuses to key anything if a digest does not match. The SRS is what makes a key pair reproducible: the same ZKIR keyed against a different SRS is a different key, so this record is as load-bearing as `port-artifact-hashes.json`. The digests are the release's own, read with `gh release view 0.3.120 --repo effectstream/binaries --json assets`.

source.note: The release publishes bls_midnight_2p0 … bls_midnight_2p19; only the five below are needed here. `bls_midnight_2p18` is the same file, byte for byte, that the README's `execute` key pair was generated against.
